---
applyTo: "analysis/**,decisions/**,continuity/**"
---
Read the relevant canonical card and its source before editing. Preserve scientific
status unless the task contains an explicit evidence-backed scientific decision.
Synchronize paired Markdown/JSON and regenerate tools/registry_links.py outputs.
Existing typed IDs distinguish result:R122, premise:F02, question:U010 and other
namespaces. Historical literature L IDs are not current open-link IDs.
Keep NOT_EVALUATED, censored, negative result and numerical failure distinct.
Do not count infrastructure as a new R result. Candidate links need rationale and
exact evidence; similarity of words is not a causal or evidential relationship.
